name: image-editing
description: Critically review and non-generatively edit food images with measurable corrections, layered compositing, and previewed color-derived masks.

interface.shortDescription: Review and technically edit food images.
interface.longDescription: Inspects food photographs, measures tone and color, reviews angle and composition, and applies bounded source-derived corrections through previewed geometric or color-similarity masks. It never generates, clones, replaces, or reconstructs scene content.
